title: TECHNICAL, ECONOMIC, AND EFFICIENT DRIVING
intro: This chapter contributes to the optimal achievement of driving motor vehicles in a technical, economic, and efficient way
reduction_of_costs: Consists fundamentally in reducing operation costs, starting from the best and easiest way to achieve it, which is reducing costs for fuel consumption and maintenance. Fuel costs are the most important in the transport industry, without dismissing, of course, what occurs from the purchase of spare parts for corrective maintenance caused by deficient operational prevention of automotive equipment.
good_driving_habits_fuel_economy: Good driving habits decrease fuel consumption by 10% or more, which can be equivalent to reducing your consumption by 9000 liters.
costa_rica_fuel_import_impact: Given that Costa Rica is not a petroleum-producing country, it must be imported, which is why excessive consumption means a greater expenditure of foreign currency, with the consequent imbalance of national finances which, upon being affected, inevitably impacts the rest of the economy—for example, by having a lower availability of monetary reserves, the backing of public investment can be negatively affected, which translates into the construction of future hospitals, highways, and ports, among other vital investments to strengthen access to work, sources of employment, and with it, a better quality of life in the country.
spare_parts_import_impact: A lower import of automotive spare parts that, as is well known, are not manufactured in the country, and also Costa Ricans earn in colones with 'the consequent leak of that expensive foreign currency'
concepto_de_conduccion_economica: Type of driving or behavior in relation to the vehicle and other operators that allows for obtaining minimum consumption of fuel, tires, and spares, thus providing better engine performance and safety to the operator.
reglas_para_una_conduccion_economica: Perform short gear changes and accelerate progressively.
Drive in the last revolutions of the gearbox.
When making gear changes, do not step fully on the accelerator.
Maintain distance with the vehicle ahead and do not accelerate to close it.

revolucion_del_motor_rpm.definition: RPM means the revolutions per minute of the engine at the time of accelerating.
revolucion_del_motor_rpm.avoidance: Over-revving the engine should be avoided as this causes unnecessary fuel consumption.

el_tacometro: It is a device used to measure revolutions per minute (RPM). It is a visual instrument that allows for good technical, economic, and efficient driving. The tachometer is nothing more and nothing less than the visual instrument that can allow for good driving of the vehicle in a TECHNICAL, EFFICIENT, and ECONOMIC way. Which consists of maintaining an oscillation between 1500 and 2800 RPM units. The analog tachometer measures RPM with a needle that turns from left to right over numbering starting at 1 and ending in 5, 7, or more, while the digital one will generally measure as an ascending or descending counter as the case may be.
habitos_al_conducir: If good driving habits are applied, fuel expenses can be reduced by 10% to 30%.

fuerzas_que_intervienen_en_el_desplazami.definition: Means: the force or power it must deploy for its movement in an economic and efficient way is to achieve technically the maximum possible performance from our engine.
fuerzas_que_intervienen_en_el_desplazami.opposing_forces: Forces that oppose the movement of a vehicle, and that the engine must overcome are:

forces_list.name: Aerodynamic resistance
forces_list.description: movement of the vehicle as a consequence of the wind; this reduces engine power and speed. It is recommended to close windows to prevent air from entering the vehicle and lifting it a few centimeters from the ground. The movement of a vehicle in the air is affected by aerodynamic force, composed of two forces: lift and drag; the first for being overcome upward and the second for being horizontal and opposite to the vehicle's movement. Lift force allows a plane to take off and sustain itself in the air; it can be observed that spoilers are placed on race cars so they do not lift at high speeds. Drag force exerts greater influence over the march of a vehicle because as already stated, it is opposite to its movement, according to its drag coefficient, which depends on its shape or aerodynamic profile that, exposed to air density mainly by the frontal area of the vehicle, determines displacement speed.

forces_list.name: Rolling resistance
forces_list.description: Is the contact the tires have with the pavement; this produces resistance to the movement the vehicle carries; therefore decreasing speed. Friction results from contact between tires and the rolling surface or roadway, producing resistance to vehicle movement composed of elements known as: rolling resistance, movement resistance coefficient measured in kilograms per ton, vehicle mass in tons, and gravity acceleration.

forces_list.name: Grade resistance
forces_list.description: If the slope is upward, it will slow the vehicle speed, but if the slope is downward, it will increase speed. Consists of driving on a route upward or downward. If it is an upward route, the inclination will tend to stop the vehicle and the engine will have to overcome it. If, on the contrary, it is a downward slope, the inclination will accelerate the vehicle, which is very important to take into account during mountain driving, because the engine can reach dangerous speeds that could even destroy it. It is recommended to use the appropriate gear or speed, such as descending in the same gear ratio used to climb the slope.

forces_list.name: Inertia resistance
forces_list.description: occurs by changing the car's speed; it is the typical backward movement that causes that. If it is intended to change a vehicle's speed, the force that opposes that change, called inertia force, which depends on the vehicle's mass, must be overcome. It is very important to know and control, especially in urban traffic, as it generates high fuel consumption and wear.

forces_list.name: Centrifugal force
forces_list.description: curvilinear movement that tends to throw it out of trajectory, occurs in very sharp curves. In a curve that is too sharp or has a small radius, centrifugal force can cause a rollover or a skid. It is important to determine when driving any type of vehicle where an inclination or superelevation of curves is directed, which is present on the right edge when the curve is to the left and on the left edge when the curve is to the right. It should not be forgotten that banking only counteracts the effect of centrifugal force, it is not eliminated, so we must always exercise the preventive action of decreasing speed or controlling the accelerator before entering the curve to later accelerate again when traveling through it, according to what the sense of touch indicates based on the centrifugal pressure perceived along a given horizontal, vertical, or mixed curve. If we accelerate into a curve and notice it has no superelevation or banking, we must reduce speed much more because, as there is no device to counteract the centrifugal effect, the latter will be null and the vehicle will tend to leave the road with much more force. IN SUMMARY, banking only counteracts centrifugal force, so if the entry speed to a curve is not adequate, the vehicle will always leave the road by skid or rollover.

curvas_caracteristicas_del_motor.description: They allow for knowing the behavior of the engine under different operation conditions—for technical driving, it is necessary to know and interpret these curves, such as information contained in technical sheets, which are data that logically or digitally the tachometer can facilitate. The rotation movement of the pistons is transformed into rotation movement, which in turn transmits to the gearbox, to the differential if it has one, and finally toward the tires, causing what is mechanically known as torsional torque.

diagramacion_de_velocidades: The torsion torque and power available over the engine's inertia voltage have to be transmitted to the tires; this function is performed by the clutch, gearbox, driveshaft, differential, and axles, which are the components of the transmission. The speed at which the engine turns is not transmitted directly to the wheels; instead, it is necessary to reduce it. This operation is performed by the gearbox and the differential.
tacometro_o_medidor_de_rpm: To measure and control the economic range of RPM there exists a device commonly known as a tachometer, which has the function of indicating the RPM at which the engine is turning when the driver steps on the accelerator or when they are not doing so. The tachometer is nothing more and nothing less than the visual instrument that can allow for good driving of the vehicle in a TECHNICAL, EFFICIENT, and ECONOMIC way. Which consists of maintaining an oscillation between 1500 and 2800 RPM units. The analog tachometer measures RPM with a needle that turns from left to right over numbering starting at 1 and ending in 5, 7, or more, while the digital one will generally measure as an ascending or descending counter as the case may be.
el_cambio_progresivo_de_velocidades: With this method, the driver makes it possible to manipulate the load easily in each ratio. The key is to make the best use of the engine's load capacity, instead of using maximum RPM. Do not forget that over-revving the engine is a bad habit, costly, and should be avoided at all times.
el_manejo_en_la_ciudad: The progressive gear change method is the best way to change speed. When driving in the city, it is also possible to save fuel by anticipating traffic lights. Stops and starts consume a significant amount of fuel.
en_la_carretera: The speed at which you drive your vehicle affects fuel consumption, wear on tires, brakes, and other parts of the unit. For example, you can reduce fuel consumption and general maintenance costs if you maintain your speed at 90 kph, where air resistance remains at a reasonable level. 90 kph is the MAXIMUM speed recommended for driving on HIGHWAYS.
seleccion_adeacuada_al_tipo_de_operacion: Engine power depends on the type of service it will be destined for. The importance of a good choice of vehicle. It is worth noting that the behavior of the driver or operator is their own image as an educated, cultured, and capable person, as well as the quality of service of the company or society to which they transmit their effort.

conduccion_economica.definition: Defined as the type of driving and behavior in relation to the vehicle and other operators that allows for obtaining minimum consumption of fuel, tires, and spares, better engine performance, and safety for the operator; fundamental principles of good driving:
conduccion_economica.pie_de_pluma: the elements necessary to produce power in a diesel or gasoline internal combustion engine are air, fuel, and heat. Of these elements, air and factors influencing it such as air filters, cylinder compression, or altitude above sea level depend little on the driver. The amount of fuel provided to the engine depends greatly on the operator. The amount of fuel is generally supplied through the accelerator, so this must be used to regulate the amount of fuel, which means driving with 'feather foot', not lead foot.

recomendaciones_practicas_para_el_automo.intro: Cold starting, continuous accelerations and braking, friction between mechanical and rolling parts, besides the resistance air offers when advancing cause over-consumption of fuel and greater pollution.
recomendaciones_practicas_para_el_automo.recommendation: Driving on the highway between 90 and 100 kph saves fuel and is safer.

anticipacion: Maintaining constant speed is a key element for savings in vehicle driving.
actitud_positiva_al_volante: The skilled and intelligent driver resists the temptation to rush, respects regulations, does not stress, stays alert, and anticipates without forcing the vehicle or traffic conditions.
aerodinamica: When driving on the highway, windows should be closed and interior ventilation used whenever possible. Open windows increase air resistance and therefore fuel consumption also increases. IF you use the air conditioning, you can increase fuel consumption by 10% to 15%.
control_de_gastos: To control fuel consumption, it is necessary to record the payments made for fuel every time you leave a gas station. A vehicle that requires tuning can over-consume 20% of fuel.
conduccion_inteligente: Any driver who applies the indications contained in this chapter will be able to immediately notice the decrease in their gas or diesel expenses. The economic difference between driving technically and driving arbitrarily can mean up to 30% savings.
